events.title: New Demo Version Available - v0.9.76
events.summary: Hey Explorers!With Steam Next Fest underway, we've been keeping busy digging through your feedback and bug reports, squashing bugs, and polishing up the demo wherever we can.This update tackles a number of issues with movement, menus, audio, and some pesky softlocks. We've also made a few more optimizations to help things run smoothly, particularly on lower graphics settings.Thanks again to everyone who's jumped into Dalton's Dinos and helped us track these things down. Full changelog below!Chan

events.title: New Demo Version Available - v0.9.51
events.summary: Hey Explorers!We've heard some of you don't care much for the color yellow, think the protagonist tends to over-explain things, and that the game can be a bit hand-holdy at times. So, we've been tinkering and cooked up a new option for disabling hints. You can find it under the Accessibility section in the Options menu.
